content_data.project_title: NutriFlow: Personalized Meal Kit Experience Redesign
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive redesign of the user journey for our personalized meal kit service, focusing on intuitive navigation, visual appeal, and enhanced customization options to boost engagement and retention.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 4 months, with an initial discovery phase (month 1) and iterative design cycles (months 2-4).
objectives: Improve conversion rates for new meal plan subscriptions by 15%.
Streamline the meal customization process for a more intuitive user experience.
deliverables: Presentation of final design concepts to stakeholders.
High-fidelity mockups for web and mobile interfaces.
Wireframes and interactive prototypes for key user flows (onboarding, meal selection, customization, checkout).
inspiration_references: Leading personalized nutrition platforms with strong UI/UX.
Case studies on successful integration of AI-driven personalization in e-commerce.
technical_specs: Scalable design system to accommodate future feature expansions.
Mobile-first design approach for optimal performance on smartphones.
